# proposal-kit

> A tiny design system for one solar proposal summary, built so an AI coding tool can't make the costly mistakes quietly. Three components carry every amount a homeowner signs: Money, PaymentLine and SavingsEstimate. Made-up data; unofficial sample.

## Read first

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules for building a view (use these three components, tokens only, never type a currency string)
- [components.json](components.json): every component with its purpose, props (types, which are required), do and don't, and one example

## Components

- [Money](src/components/Money.tsx): cents in, formatted currency out
- [PaymentLine](src/components/PaymentLine.tsx): monthly payment; apr and termMonths are required
- [SavingsEstimate](src/components/SavingsEstimate.tsx): requires assumptions, always says Estimated
- [shadcn/ui primitives](src/components/ui/): Card, Badge, Button, Separator

## Tokens and checks

- [Tokens](src/styles/tokens.css): color, type, spacing and radius, light and dark
- [Lint rules](eslint-rules/index.js): no-raw-currency, payment-needs-terms, tokens-only, savings-needs-estimate, no-color-only-status
- [Reference view](src/views/ProposalSummary.tsx): a proposal summary built only from the kit

## Optional

- [Storybook](https://gauravbasantani.github.io/proposal-kit/): every state of each component, with a "For AI tools" block
- [Eval](evals/README.md): fresh Claude Code runs with and without these docs, and what the checks caught
